program='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for block_r in range(3):\n        for r in range(h):\n            src_r = h - 1 - r if block_r != 1 else r\n            row = []\n            for block_c in range(3):\n                for c in range(w):\n                    src_c = w - 1 - c if block_c != 1 else c\n                    row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])\n            out.append(row)\n    return out\n'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
